group.name: Banking aur Insurance
group.intro: Bank ki pay bank wage settlement ke hisaab se hoti hai, isliye salary lagbhag starting gross amount hai. Negative marking question ke marks ka 0.25 hai. Age relaxation: OBC 3, SC/ST 5, PwBD 10 (+3 OBC, +5 SC/ST), ex-servicemen 5. Haal ke IBPS aur SBI notices mein joining ke samay credit-history (CIBIL) ki shart rahi hai; exact rule har notice mein alag hota hai, isliye apna notice zaroor padhein.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.0: Final-year students aam taur par graduate exams mein apply kar sakte hain, agar notice ki cut-off date tak unke paas degree hogi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.1: Bank exams mein EWS ko reservation milta hai, lekin age relaxation nahi.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.2: 1984 ke dangon se prabhavit log: +5 saal.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.3: Widows, divorced aur judicially separated mahilayein: kai clerk notices mein 35 (UR), 38 (OBC), 40 (SC/ST) tak.
group.ageRelaxation.notes.4: Attempt limits: SBI PO mein General ke liye 4, OBC ke liye 7 aur SC/ST ke liye unlimited attempts. RBI Grade B mein General / EWS ke liye 6 attempts.
